title: Protester interrupts JD Vance rally in Hendersonville demanding Epstein files release
seoTitle: Hendersonville protest at JD Vance rally

tea.why: A protester interrupted a political rally to demand transparency regarding Jeffrey Epstein's files.
tea.want: The release of the Epstein files.
tea.changed: Oct 19: Security escorted a heckler out of a political rally in Hendersonville after he shouted for the release of Epstein files.

summary: On Monday, 19 October 2026, a protester interrupted a political rally held by US Vice President JD Vance at the Hyder Warehouse in Hendersonville, North Carolina. Organised by the Trump 47 Committee to support local midterm candidates, the event drew attention when a man seated behind the podium stood up holding a sign and shouted for the release of Jeffrey Epstein's files and invoked child welfare. Security personnel escorted the protester out of the venue amid booing and chants from the crowd. In response to the interruption, Vance made remarks about border crossings that critics interpreted as implying the protester was in the country illegally. California Governor Gavin Newsom and various commentators criticised the vice president's reaction to the demonstration.
response: Security personnel escorted the protester out of the venue. Vice President JD Vance responded during the event with a remark about border crossings, which drew criticism from figures including California Governor Gavin Newsom.

updates.text: A protester interrupted a political rally in Hendersonville, North Carolina, demanding the release of Epstein files.
